newsitem.title: USA: Nine West says under federal investigation.
newsitem.headline: Nine West says under federal investigation.

text.p: Women's footwear maker Nine West Group said Tuesday the Securities and Exchange Commission was investigating how it books sales and revenues and other practices.
In an amended annual report filed with the regulatory agency, Nine West said it was cooperating with the commission in its "formal order of investigation."
In the filing, Nine West said the agency had entered a formal order of investigation on April 10.
The Stamford, Conn.-based company said it had been cooperating fully with the commission when the original investigation was informal.
Nine West said it does not anticipate the investigation will have any material adverse financial effect on the company.
Nine West makes and markets women's footwear.
